history.summary: A 999LH 2006 4BR at Monterey Park (D05 West Coast/Clementi) for $2.65M / $1,940 psf, with a strong 6.79%/yr URA resale CAGR (28 txns) but priced ~7% ABOVE the $1,819 district median and a poor 1.29km MRT walk. Quasi-freehold tenure and One-North/JLR catalysts are real, but the very low score_1000 (295) flags the rich pricing.
history.rating_rationale: Tension here: appreciation is genuinely good (6.79%/yr over 28 txns) and 999-year tenure removes lease risk, with D05 backed by One-North and the future Jurong Region Line. But the listing PSF $1,940 is ~7% above the $1,819 median, the 1.29km/15-min walk to JE7 Pandan Reservoir is weak, and the $2.65M 4BR quantum thins the pool — driving the very low score_1000 of 295. The location/tenure/appreciation pull up against an over-median ask; nets to Neutral, contingent on negotiating closer to median PSF.
red_flags: Listed PSF ~7% above the $1,819 URA district median (paying up)
Poor transit — 1.29km / 15-min walk to JE7 Pandan Reservoir MRT
catalysts: Strong 6.79%/yr URA resale appreciation over 28 txns
One-North tech-hub demand and future Jurong Region Line connectivity
